text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting!! 
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving specialty: 
Demon Dodgeball!!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Out of the 8 teams gathered here, which 
one will claim the glory 
and step onto the Winning Live stage!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, wonderful♪ 
Baku-chan, Tannhauser-chan, they suit both 
of you so well!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Wearing this uniform really gets me 
all fired up and full of 'mun'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! As the Class Rep, I shall hype up 
our team and the spectators alike!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels kind of a shame that only 
the two 'Demon Generals' 
get to wear the uniforms during the match.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's to make it easy for the audience to 
see 
who the 'Demon Generals'—the scorers—are.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For the first match, Tannhauser-san and 
Bakushin O-san are the 'Demon Generals.' 
We'll rotate the role as needed depending 
on the situation after that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All five of us wearing the uniforms 
together is saved for the very end— 
something to look forward to at the 
Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, that'll be here in no time! 
...Oh? By the way, where is Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san is currently on an important 
errand— 
Ah, speak of the devil.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —I have safely returned.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. 
How were Flower-san and Rice-san doing?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The 'Umamusume Three-Legged Race' was a 
fierce, chaotic battle— 
however, both displayed their true 
capabilities and achieved a magnificent 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—It made me feel inspired to do my best as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my heart is pounding more and 
more... 
I can finally enjoy Thanksgiving with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best, everyone. 
We will stand on the Winning Live stage 
and see that beautiful view, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Together, as Team 'Five Stars'...!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text:
—And now, Round 1 of the Thanksgiving 
Demon Dodgeball division begins!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Here it begins, Umamusume Demon Dodgeball! 
Going on the offensive first is Team 'Five 
Stars'!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The second team, Team 'Glace Grazie', is 
already fleeing the court 
and heading straight for the Central 
Plaza!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The entire academy grounds serve as the 
playing field for this Demon Dodge! 
The crowd is already roaring at this 
massive-scale showdown right from the very 
first match!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Baku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood! You won't get away from meee!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Team 'Five Stars' gives chase in hot 
pursuit! 
Everyone in the Central Plaza! Demon 
Dodgeball passing through!!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, this is it! Demon Dodgeball 
wouldn't be the same without this!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Demon Dodgeball! Clear the area, Demon 
Dodgeball incoming!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The opponents are scattering! 
Bakushin O-san, now—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood, here I go! Meteorite—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: FAAAALLL!!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text: Team 'Five Stars' scores 2 points!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that...!? What on earth was 
that attack!? 
Just when it looked like a mispass, an 
unexpected aerial strike out of nowhere!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even tell what happened for a 
second. 
This year's Demon Dodge... is kind of 
insane...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan, nice point!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! 
Look at this excitement—as expected of 
your Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pulling that off cleanly in an actual 
match is no easy feat. 
It really boosts the team's morale... 
Truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My nerves are starting to fade away! 
We got this, we got this! Bring it oooon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status: 'Exciting.' 
We shall press the advantage and overwhelm 
them all at once.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is where it counts, everyone! Let's 
make some noise!

text_block_list.name: All Five
text_block_list.text: YEAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Team 'Five Stars', huh... 
Haha, they've put together quite a nice 
lineup. However—
